eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of nHCM
* On a stable regimen of guideline-directed medical therapy for nHCM
* NYHA functional class II or III
* NT-proBNP \>300 pg/mL
* Body weight of 50 to 100 kg, inclusive, and BMI ≤40 kg/m2, inclusive
* Adequate renal function
* Not pregnant, and willing to use acceptable birth control methods
* Able and willing to comply with study procedures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any evidence of left ventricular outflow tract obstruction (LVOTO)
* Implantation of an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) within 6 months
* History or current evidence of a clinically significant or uncontrolled underlying condition
* Unable to tolerate subcutaneous dosing
* Any reason that in the opinion of the Investigator would lead to the inability of the participant to comply with the protocol
